title: Israeli Drone Strikes Kamal Adwan Hospital Courtyard, Wounding Staff
detail: An Israeli quadcopter drone dropped an explosive on the courtyard of Kamal Adwan Hospital in Beit Lahia, northern Gaza, wounding three hospital workers/civilians in the courtyard and injuring maintenance workers nearby, according to WAFA. The strike occurred despite the hospital sitting inside the so-called 'Green Zone' under Israeli control. The Palestinian Health Ministry called it part of a systematic campaign against Gaza's healthcare infrastructure, and the attack added to international pressure over Israel's continued detention without charge of the hospital's director, Dr. Hussam Abu Safia.

media.caption: Israeli drone strike wounds hospital workers at Kamal Adwan Hospital, Beit Lahia — July 10, 2026
